items.source:
Used as connection or client identifier to select the MCP clients that the tool
change listener is associated with.
items.translation: 用作连接或客户端标识符，以选择工具变更监听器所关联的 MCP 客户端。

items.source: The annotated method must have a void return type for synchronous consumers, or can return Mono<Void> for asynchronous consumers. The method should accept a single parameter of type List<McpSchema.Tool> that represents the updated list of tools after the change notification.
items.translation: 注释方法对于同步消费者必须具有 void 返回类型，或者对于异步消费者可以返回 `Mono<Void>`。该方法应接受一个类型为 `List<McpSchema.Tool>` 的单个参数，该参数表示变更通知后更新的工具列表。

items.source: Methods annotated with this annotation are used to listen for notifications when the list of available tools changes on an MCP server. According to the MCP specification, servers that declare the listChanged capability will send notifications when their tool list is modified.
items.translation: 使用此注解标注的方法用于监听 MCP 服务器上可用工具列表变更时的通知。根据 MCP 规范，声明了 `listChanged` 能力的服务器会在其工具列表被修改时发送通知。
• MCP 工具列表变更通知

items.source: the client identifiers, or empty array to listen to all clients
items.translation: 客户端标识符，或传入空数组以监听所有客户端。

items.source:
Annotation for methods that handle tool list change notifications from MCP servers.
This annotation is applicable only for MCP clients.
items.translation:
用于处理来自 MCP 服务器的工具列表变更通知的方法注解。  
此注解仅适用于 MCP 客户端。

items.source:
@McpToolListChanged(clients = "test-client")
public void onToolListChanged(List<McpSchema.Tool> updatedTools) {
    // Handle tool list change notification with the updated tools
    logger.info("Tool list updated, now contains {} tools", updatedTools.size());
    // Process the updated tool list
}

@McpToolListChanged(clients = "test-client")
public Mono<Void> onToolListChangedAsync(List<McpSchema.Tool> updatedTools) {
    // Handle tool list change notification asynchronously
    return processUpdatedTools(updatedTools);
}
items.translation:
@McpToolListChanged(clients = "test-client")
public void onToolListChanged(List<McpSchema.Tool> updatedTools) {
    // 处理工具列表变更通知，包含更新后的工具
    logger.info("工具列表已更新，现在包含 {} 个工具", updatedTools.size());
    // 处理更新后的工具列表
}

@McpToolListChanged(clients = "test-client")
public Mono<Void> onToolListChangedAsync(List<McpSchema.Tool> updatedTools) {
    // 异步处理工具列表变更通知
    return processUpdatedTools(updatedTools);
}
